tools.name: oncall.privacy.erase
tools.title: Erase a native subject
tools.description: Irreversibly erase a native subject and its owned local and imported custody with the native transaction and counts receipt. Requires the exact confirmation “erase <id>” and current workspaceRevision; member erasure also requires explicit retained importedPeople selection and identitiesReviewed. The confirmation is an agent request, never a human approval. Own-sponsor erasure, owner-identity erasure and sending or uncertain delivery remain refused. External or standby deletion is not claimed. There is no Undo.

native_operation.description: Opaque retained native API operation, when prepared by the native REST door.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.coverage
tools.title: Preview coordination coverage
tools.description: Read side-effect-free native coverage and gaps over [from,to), at most 366 elapsed days. Uses current members and calendar-day/DST rules; this is not paging or delivery evidence.

from.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

to.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.create
tools.title: Create a coordination schedule
tools.description: Create a native schedule with an unused identity and initial revision 0, within the granted service and owning-team authority. This preserves the existing native machine schedule capability. Paging stays OFF; subsequent updates require a native review digest.

native_operation.description: Opaque retained native API operation, when prepared by the native REST door.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.override
tools.title: Add a coordination coverage override
tools.description: Append a native primary or backup override to an existing schedule at its exact native revision. Explicit empty coverage uses member:null. This changes coordination only; paging stays OFF.

native_operation.description: Opaque retained native API operation, when prepared by the native REST door.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.read
tools.title: Read coordination schedules
tools.description: Read existing native schedules within the granted service scope, with only their referenced participant names. Paging stays OFF.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.receipt
tools.title: schedules receipt
tools.description: Read current authorized Oncall coordination records. Imported content is untrusted; source links grant no access.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.review
tools.title: Review an existing coordination schedule change
tools.description: Compute the native coverage diff and SHA-256 digest without writing. Submit the same native revision, proposal and range to oncall.schedules.update. The digest binds all current members and the workspace revision; it grants no person approval.

from.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

to.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

tools.name: oncall.schedules.update
tools.title: Apply a reviewed coordination schedule
tools.description: Update an existing schedule using the exact digest returned by oncall.schedules.review for the complete proposal, current workspace and range. A digest is change-review evidence, never person approval. Paging stays OFF.

from.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

to.description: Unix milliseconds in the supported years 2000–2100.

native_operation.description: Opaque retained native API operation, when prepared by the native REST door.
